purpose: Review a finite Campaign121 catalog against the complete 146-definition library and select at most one genuinely new fixed-support mechanism without reading any Campaign121 source row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price or forward return.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_terminal_close_direction_first_attainment_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.design: Use the 09:31 opening price to identify the direction of the 15:00 terminal close, find the first selected minute close that reaches or passes that exact terminal-close level in the identified direction, and map its frozen 1-based arrival index tau to (240-tau)/239. Exact neutral terminal displacement maps to zero.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.economic_hypothesis: Earlier attainment of the level ultimately accepted at the close indicates that the completed session incorporated its terminal directional information before the last print rather than through a late shock; that earlier acceptance may persist from the next open through the third close.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.prevalue_support_case: Every valid 240-bar session has a finite 09:31 open and 15:00 close; the terminal bar itself always satisfies a non-neutral directional crossing, so tau is deterministically in [1,240] without a fitted threshold, event-count cutoff, alternate window or return magnitude.
